TC addome con mdc: stadiazione epatica,: Contrast-enhanced abdominal CT: hepatic staging, two reconstructions compared
Metastasi epatiche da carcinoma colorett: Small hypovascular liver metastases from colorectal carcinoma: at 25% reduced dose the smallest one is lost (LDCT L014)
Uomo di 51 anni con carcinoma del colon-: 51-year-old man with colorectal carcinoma, portal phase abdominal CT to look for liver metastases. 5 mm slices every 3 mm, soft kernel. You are given two series of the same exam: the first at full dose (CTDIvol about 8.4 mGy), the second reconstructed as if the dose had been reduced to 25% (about 2.1 mGy). Whether to adopt the reduced-dose protocol is being considered.
Confronta le due serie in finestra addom: Compare the two series in abdominal window (L 60 W 350-400): look for the liver lesions in each and judge whether the reduced dose is adequate for this clinical question.
Le due serie vengono dagli stessi dati::
The two series come from the same data: the Mayo collection (LDCT-and-Projection-data) inserted into the sinogram the noise that a scan at 25% of the dose would have and reconstructed again. The anatomy is identical slice by slice: only the noise changes.
Quantum noise grows as 1/√dose: at 25% of the dose it theoretically doubles (here the standard deviation measured in the liver goes from about 16 to 24 HU, because part of the variability is tissue). A hypovascular metastasis in the portal phase differs from the liver by 15-30 HU: with this noise the 6 mm lesion of the right lobe, in a lateral-posterior location (image 53) can no longer be separated from the background, while those of 7.5-10 mm remain visible.
Practical rule: the dose is chosen according to the task. High-contrast tasks (lung nodules, urinary stones, fractures) tolerate very low doses; low-contrast tasks (liver lesions, pancreas, brain) do not. Iterative or AI reconstructions recover part of the quality but must be validated on the task, not on appearance.
In the reduced dose, noise blotches that can mimic lesions also appear: noise creates both false negatives and false positives.
Basso contrasto (fegato) = il rumore con: Low contrast (liver) = noise matters: the dose is chosen on the task, not on the appearance of the image.
